ButtonDragModel.luau.description: Tracks mouse and touch dragging over a GuiButton and exposes normalized button position, accumulated drag delta, and pressed-state observables. Public entry points include `ButtonDragModel.new`, `ButtonDragModel.IsPressed`, `ButtonDragModel.ObserveIsPressed`, `ButtonDragModel.ObserveIsPressedBrio`, `ButtonDragModel.ObserveDragDelta`, `ButtonDragModel.GetDragDelta`, `ButtonDragModel.GetDragPosition`,…
